aiNews.title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls

aiNews.summary: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

aiNews.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
aiNews.summary: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.
